why: Measured on 2 October 2026 on dev at fb8abba with no change applied, by lane F of the server split (PRDCT-3154): the baseline run on a laptop (1797 passed, 25 failed) and the first CI run on macos-latest (1797 passed, 28 failed), 15 failures in common. `specs` lists the checks that failed on both, by name: deterministic on dev, cause not investigated by that lane. `unstable` lists the specs that crashed before finishing on both (a crash can never be a known check: it would hide every regression before it) and the specs whose failures differed between the two machines or between two runs on one; their results are counted and printed as UNSTABLE and are not a gate until the spec is fixed (PRDCT-1762 names the boot race behind several of them). A listed check that passes, or an unstable spec that passes in full, is reported by run.mjs so this file shrinks. On 5 October 2026 (lane F round 3) empty-group and hidden-session-restore joined the unstable specs: they fail on both machines with the same boot-race shape (a group created through MCP in the first seconds after the page loads is never drawn: at 2 s it is not, at 3 s it is, in both modes; whether the boot restore wipes it or it is never added was not established, PRDCT-1762), in-process and attached alike, and pass with a 12 s settle instead of 4 s; measured under a load average of 70 to 100.
